name: @hl-bos/hype-video-app
description: 5-Star Hype Video (5-Star Sports Media) — create a hype project, upload a photo or clip, enter the athlete's details, pick a template and tone, and get a complete, fact-checked hype package: scripts, voiceover, caption, hashtags, on-screen text and ready-to-use prompts for video and music services. Runs on this computer only; projects and media are stored locally and are private.
